title: Vegetable Delight Soup
description: A hearty and comforting soup made with a variety of colorful vegetables and a hint of spice.
instructions: 1. Chop the carrots, celery, and onion into bite-sized pieces.
3. In a large pot, sauté the chopped vegetables and garlic in a little bit of water until they're tender.
4. Add the diced potatoes, stock, and vegetable delight to the pot.
5. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and let it simmer for 20-25 minutes.
6. Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
